headlines.title: Cisco, Nvidia Tackle AI's Growing Data Center Bottleneck
headlines.summary: Cisco is partnering with Nvidia on a new generation of optical networking technology designed to handle the exploding amount of data moving through AI data centers. Cisco President and Chief Product Officer Jeetu Patel explains why increasingly powerful AI agents could consume far more network bandwidth than humans performing the same tasks, and how faster, more power-efficient connections could help hundreds of thousands of GPUs operate together while lowering the cost of AI. He joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech.

headlines.title: Cisco Advances Scalability and Openness at OCP 2026
headlines.summary: Today at the Open Compute Project (OCP) Global Summit 2026, Cisco (Nasdaq: CSCO) introduced new silicon, systems and optical innovations that advance open AI infrastructure from rack-scale compute to distributed AI capacity. Together, the announcements demonstrate how Cisco is engineering the network as a coherent, programmable architecture while preserving the openness and choice customers expect in the super intelligence era.

headlines.title: NVIDIA and Cisco Introduce New Pluggable Optics Form Factor to Scale AI Factories
headlines.summary: New Transceivers Enable AI Builders to Scale Compute Within the Same Network Footprint While Reducing Networking’s Share of the Power Budget Ultra-Dense Small Form Factor Pluggable Ultra-Dense Small Form Factor Pluggable is designed to be the first module to support 400Gb/s-per-lane electrical signals, enabling capacity up to 12.8Tb/s so AI factory builders can scale Ethernet AI fabrics, while extending a proven deployment model across multiple generations of data center networks.

headlines.title: Is Cisco Stock Paying You Enough For The Swings?
headlines.summary: Investors holding Cisco Systems (CSCO) stock alongside broad market index funds are navigating a shifting business model. The company's sales of AI infrastructure to hyperscalers, the largest cloud companies, accounted for about 6% of fiscal 2026 revenue. That figure stood at less than 2% a year earlier. This rapid transition leaves the stock exposed to sharper price movements than the broader market. So what has Cisco paid you over five years for those swings.

headlines.title: Zacks Investment Ideas feature highlights: Meta Platform, NVIDIA, Palantir, Cisco, SanDisk and Qualcomm
headlines.summary: Is AI in a bubble? NVIDIA and Palantir hit record highs as valuations, bearish sentiment and historical comparisons suggest the AI rally may have further to run.

description: Cisco Systems, Inc. designs, develops, and sells technologies to power, help, secure, and draw insights from the internet in the Americas, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, the Asia Pacific, Japan, and China. The company provides data center switching; network security, identity and access management, and secure access service edge; identity and agentic security solutions; interconnects public and private wireline and mobile networks, delivering connectivity to campus, data center, and branch networks; WEBEX suite, collaboration devices, and contact center; communication platform as a service software, including perpetual licenses, subscription arrangements, and hardware solutions; network assurance and observability suite; accelerated issue resolution, software support, and hardware replacement; professional services, such as planning, design, implementation, and high-value consulting; service and support packages, financing, and managed network services; and regional, national, and international wireline carriers, webscale products, internet, and cable. It also provides wireless products, including indoor and outdoor coverage designed for seamless roaming use of voice, video, and data applications; end-to-end collaboration solutions through cloud, on-premise, or within hybrid cloud environments. In addition, it offers technical support services. The company serves businesses, public institutions, governments, and service providers. It sells its products and services directly, through systems integrators, service providers, and resellers, and distributors. Cisco Systems, Inc. was incorporated in 1984 and is headquartered in San Jose, California.
